name: pi-permission-system
notes: Forked from gotgenes/pi-packages; local wrapper-floor rework (fallback mode) intentionally diverges from upstream. v32.1.0 sync adopted upstream's region-scoped tool-surface removal for custom system prompts (#919) and configurable permission-dialog hotkeys via permissionDialogKeys (#927), while preserving the fork's named permission profiles, session role layer, wrapper floors, and forwarded-decision broadcast. The bash salvage merge keeps fork's parseProgram recursion (wrapperFloors) alongside upstream's withSalvagedRoots. 2026-09-19 conflict-surface pass: whitespace churn reverted to upstream bytes (fake-ts-node.ts byte-identical; service.ts keeps only 3 re-export lines; forwarded-request-server.ts and permission-manager.ts import blocks restored; extension-config/permissions-service/shell-tool-alias tests keep only their semantic lines). Fork test describes moved to fork-only test files (config-loader.fork, config-schema.fork, forwarded-request-server.fork, permission-events.fork, profiles-gating.fork). The duplicated parseCommandUnits closure now lives once in fork-only src/access-intent/bash/wrapper-parse.ts (makeParseProgram factory) consumed by program.ts and sync-commands.ts. Orphan src/denial-messages.ts (a revived copy of the upstream-dissolved module, zero references) deleted. Never let biome/prettier reformat upstream files in this package — keep upstream formatting byte-stable. 2026-09-19 P2 pass: the ~450-line wrapper-classification block moved out of src/access-intent/bash/command-enumeration.ts into fork-only src/access-intent/bash/wrapper-floors.ts (only classifyWrapperCommand is exported; makeCommandUnit now passes text/words/parseProgram so there is no runtime cycle — upstream keeps only the import + the classify-then-fall-through seam; do NOT re-inline on sync), and the profile-scope block in permission-manager.resolvePermissions moved to fork-only src/policy/profile-scope.ts (resolveProfileScope; cacheKey/env-freeze machinery stays).
